text:
Mira Santos: Hi folks — Mira joining Platform (PST remote) today. Quick checklist Qs: MDM + laptop image, VPN/SSO, access to infra repos, and permission to spin up a dev GCP project. Also I'm allergic to cats but love plants. Slightly embarrassing fun fact: I juggle tennis balls badly.

Priya Rao: welcome Mira!! :tada: People Ops should have sent Jamf + SSO invite. If you don't see invites in 24h ping @people-ops or DM me. I'm your buddy for the first two weeks — happy to hop on a 30m intro.

Eliot Chen: hey Mira 3 adding you to #platform and #platform-oncall read-only for now. For repo access, share your github handle in DM and I'll add you. For GCP projects, there's a short request form: https://intra.redwood/gcp/request — put "dev-project" in the name and tag me.

Sam Wells: hardware note: we shipped the MacBook Pro image this morning; if you need dual monitors or a standing desk request, file a ticket at https://intra.redwood/hw-requests. ETA laptop 48-72h.

PeopleOpsBot: New hire onboarded: Mira Santos. Tasks created: jamf_invite, sso_setup, hw_shipment, buddy_assignment.

Jordan Park: For SSH keys, please run:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "mira@redwood.ai"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```

DM the pubkey to me. VPN is okta + WireGuard; SSO will provision the WireGuard profile automatically once SSO is active. If you get a WireGuard error, send the error ID from the client logs.

Ally Nguyen: welcome Mira! :wave: If you want a starter infra sandbox I can spin up a small terraform workspace for your account. Also, if you actually juggle, we have a weekly "skillshare" session where people demo odd hobbies.

Mira Santos: Thanks everyone. I filled the GCP request form and DM'd my github handle and pubkey to Eliot and Jordan. Quick question: who handles billing permissions for dev projects?

Eliot Chen: billing perms require manager approval + infra-payroll owner signoff. For dev projects we usually give `viewer` by default and add billing on a per-request basis. Tag me and @finance if you need it enabled.

Mira Santos: Got it. One last tiny ask: can someone confirm the supported macOS client version? I'm on Sonoma.

Jordan Park: Sonoma is supported with WireGuard client v1.0.220+; if you hit an issue run `wg-show-logs` and paste the error code.

Priya Rao: welcome again Mira! I'll set up our buddy intro and send a calendar invite for 30m. Also bring a plant to the skillshare if you like :seedling:
